help.intro: Click Copy link and add the link in your calendar app by hand:
help.google.after: and paste the link. On a phone there's a known issue: the link opens the Google Calendar app, which can't add a calendar by URL. Instead, type calendar.google.com in the browser's address bar, turn on Desktop site in the browser menu, then Other calendars → + → From URL. The calendar then appears in the app too; if it doesn't, turn on Sync for it in the app's settings. Google refreshes it with a delay, usually from a few hours to a day.
help.apple: on a Mac: File → New Calendar Subscription; on an iPhone: Settings → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar.
